newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam's president says recovering from illness.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam's president says recovering from illness.

text.p: Vietnam's President Le Duc Anh, who suffered a stroke in mid-November last year, issued a statement on Friday saying he was recovering.
The brief statement, carried by the official Vietnam News Agency, quoted Anh, 76, as saying he wished to thank people who had sent messages of concern during his illness.

"The illness is now over. My health is in the process of recovery. On behalf of my family and myself I would like to sincerely thank everyone, and would like to send my best wishes to all the people, cadres and friends," he was quoted as saying.
The VNA statement was the first to quote Anh in person since he fell ill.
VNA added that senior members of the elite politburo had visited Anh on Friday and expressed the hope that he would be well enough to return to work soon.
General Le Duc Anh is a member of Vietnam's leadership triumvirate alongside Communist Party Secretary General Do Muoi and Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet.
